test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: In the following question, four letter pairs are given. The letters on left side of (–) is related to the letters on the right side of (–) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefcd090e4721ab168474cd72dc7f0a88835716ce3c569f68482016e79ea81ae.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

1) TBU – XFX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/120b6193529d21931336f2ded176d71cf9c50cd81760b7148b0661d38a44c0a4.png] 

2) MLA – EPQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40bad07ac327c63972053abfbda54e79c8f836727641bffbab53a26d689254ef.png] 

3) GRF – JVK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9262df3fe28f39a6c5a440118fff97f839620248d257776a0bde57ce96f08912.png] 

4) HVX – BZL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb307b74e913214fb1f7df03934b7d5a7e37e39b0e06ff53a2d4cfb7e0df3726.png] 

Hence, ‘**TBU – XFX**’ is the odd one out.
